## DATA COLLECTION

### Citi Bike Data

- Jersey City 2025–2026 annual ZIP files
- Extraction of CSV files
   
### Weather Data

- Open-Meteo API
- Temperature, precipitation, wind, cloud cover, etc.

### Geographic Data

- Jersey City neighborhood GeoJSON
  
### Data Period

- 2025: January 2025 – December 2025
- 2026: January 2026 – June 2026
